description: This file defines the TermSelection class for Drupal taxonomy module, providing entity reference selection and access control for taxonomy terms.

classes.name: TermSelection
classes.description: Provides specific access control and entity reference selection for taxonomy terms in Drupal.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns default configuration with sorting by name ascending.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds configuration form, disables sorting options for taxonomy terms.

methods.name: getReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Retrieves referenceable taxonomy term entities, considering user permissions and published status.

methods.name: countReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Counts total referenceable taxonomy term entities matching criteria.

methods.name: buildEntityQuery
methods.description: Builds entity query with access control based on user permissions.

methods.name: createNewEntity
methods.description: Creates a new taxonomy term entity and sets it as published.

methods.name: validateReferenceableNewEntities
methods.description: Validates that new entities are published if user lacks admin permission.
